records.claim: Due to theoretical concern (and not proven risks), some healthcare providers may recommend that men taking mycophenolate wait at least three months after stopping treatment before trying to conceive a pregnancy. In general, exposures that men have are unlikely to increase the risks to a pregnancy. For more information, please see the MotherToBaby fact sheet Paternal Exposures at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/paternal-exposures-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: If a man takes mycophenolate, could it affect fertility or increase the chance of birth defects?
